obligations.text: No Codex binary version is qualified except by a recorded pass of spec 004's full negative suite run against this adapter with its own fixtures; a pass by the Claude Code adapter never counts.
The adapter never reads, writes or rewrites the user's own Codex configuration directory; every file it gives Codex is in a per-run directory the supervisor creates.
Exactly one terminal turn event maps to an outcome; zero or more than one, an error event, or a thread id that changes mid-stream maps to interrupted, never completed.
A launch whose governing PreToolUse hook Codex does not report as enabled, synchronous and trusted for the workspace refuses before the turn starts.
Spec 004's negative suite passes against this adapter on recorded Codex fixtures; a source check finds no Codex name outside its crate; a run leaves the user's Codex directory byte-identical.

sectionHeadings: 3.2 The stream and the outcome mapping
record.summary: Proposes statecraft-adapter-codex, the second provider adapter under the conditional F-07 lift of 2026-10-20. It mirrors the Claude Code adapter's shape: codex exec's JSONL stream mapped to spec 003's closed outcomes, a constructed environment, a per-run CODEX_HOME in the spirit of spec 042, and harness delivery under spec 008 without touching the user's own Codex configuration. It declares its capabilities through the seam proposed as spec 047 and is built only after that seam merges. It is qualified only by its own pass of spec 004's negative suite on fixtures recorded from a named Codex version. An appendix records preloop's facts on other harnesses as reference for later adapters; no code.
record.title: A Codex adapter, built on the capability seam and admitted only by its own pass of spec 004's suite
